description: Redeem a gift code (handed out by a giveaway site or a newsletter) for this account's gift pack, exactly like POST /v1/gift-codes/redeem. One pack per account, only in an account's first days. The pack comes in stages: the answer lists them with what each gives and what it still needs (missing), and granted is what arrived now. Call gift_code_pack later to collect a stage that has come due.

code.description: the coupon code, e.g. from an invite reward
